description: Model.find_module can return an old lookup result after the registered module tree is edited.
trigger: Look up an absent string key, insert a module with that key into the public module tree, then repeat the same lookup on the same model while the miss is cached.
expected_behavior: The prior scan would observe the newly inserted module.
actual_behavior: The decorated method returns the cached None. Replacing a previously found module can similarly leave a cached reference to the old object. The directly observed in-tree callers in test_qgemm and test_quant_fn use existing keys, not this mutation sequence; the conversion lookup uses the separate Module method.

verification.description: Applied the decorator to the extracted lookup and repeated a miss after inserting a stand-in layer. Only the undecorated version observed the new layer.
verification.limits: This is a conditional API behavior check, not evidence that any inspected caller edits the tree between lookups.

introductions.rationale: This commit adds lru_cache to Model.find_module, retaining a prior miss across module-tree insertion.
